title: Late-Cancellation History and Extension Visits — Referrals & Prior Authorizations Criteria
content:
The late-cancellation trim of the extension visits on an extended In-Group Specialist Referral, HMO Specialist Referral, Out-of-Network Referral or Physical Therapy Episode Authorization (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) follows the late-cancellation fees assessed on the patient's In-Person Appointments in the 12 months before the handling date, a fee later waived still counting as assessed: two or more take two visits away, exactly one takes one visit away, and none takes nothing.

## Criteria

- **Counted:** each late-cancellation fee assessed on any of the patient's In-Person Appointments and dated within the 12 months before the handling date, including a fee that was later waived.
- **Not counted:** fees assessed more than 12 months before the handling date, and fees of other kinds.

## Illustrations (hypothetical histories)

| Late-cancellation fees in the 12 months | Of which later waived | Trim |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 1 | two visits taken away |
| 1 | 1 | one visit taken away |
| 0 | — | nothing taken away |
